identity.name: Rare AppID usage to rare destination with PowerShell and C2
identity.summary: An attacker uses PowerShell to download a payload from a rare IP, then executes it, triggering a rare AppID usage to a rare destination. Cortex should detect the anomalous network and process behavior
identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to download a payload from a rare IP, then executes it, triggering a rare AppID usage to a rare destination. Cortex should detect the anomalous network and process behavior.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Rare AppID usage to rare destination
biocs.description: Detection of rare application ID usage to a rare destination IP
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| comp count() as events by agent_hostname, agent_hostname
| sort desc events

abiocs.name: PowerShell download to rare IP
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation of PowerShell downloading from rare IP
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path like '%DownloadFile%'
| comp count() as events by actor_process_image_name, agent_hostname
| sort desc events
abiocs.causality_anchor: powershell.exe downloading file from rare IP

xql_queries.name: Detect rare IP usage from PowerShell
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| comp count() as events by actor_process_image_name, agent_hostname
| sort desc events
